name: @hobo/provider-turso
description: HoBo Turso (libSQL) binding of the ephemeral-state port: opaque incarnation:revision versions, putIfAbsent, compareAndSet, versioned delete, increment with on-create/refresh TTL modes, expire and getMany as single atomic statements over @libsql/client, lazy TTL expiry with a bounded purge, a request and rows meter for Turso's rows-read/rows-written allowance, and the TURSO_DATABASE_URL/TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN environment helper.
